Class AuthService

java.lang.Object
backend.logic.AuthService
public class AuthService extends Object
The AuthService class provides authentication and session management functionality for the Typing Duel application.

This class is responsible for:

  • User login and credential validation
  • New account registration
  • Password recovery using security questions
  • Managing the currently logged-in user session

Functional Requirements Satisfied:

  • FR 3.1.6: Login Screen and Multiple User Support
  • FR 3.1.14: Forgot Password system with security questions

This class interacts with FileDataStore to persist and retrieve player data.

Team 49 – CS2212B Winter 2026

  • Method Details

    • login

      public boolean login(String username, String password)
      Authenticates a user by validating their username and password. If authentication succeeds, the current session is updated.
      Parameters:
      username - the username entered by the user
      password - the password entered by the user
      Returns:
      true if authentication is successful; false otherwise

    • register

      public boolean register(String username, String password, String[] questions, String[] answers, String guardianCode)
      Registers a new user account with associated security questions.

      If a guardian code is provided, the account is created as a AccountType.PARENT_TEACHER; otherwise, it is a standard player account.

      Parameters:
      username - the unique username for the new account
      password - the password for the new account
      questions - an array of security questions
      answers - an array of corresponding answers to the security questions
      guardianCode - an optional code indicating a guardian account
      Returns:
      true if registration is successful; false if the username already exists or saving fails

    • verifySecurityAnswers

      public boolean verifySecurityAnswers(String username, String[] providedAnswers)
      Verifies whether the provided security answers match the stored answers for a given user.

      Comparison is case-insensitive and ignores leading/trailing whitespace.

      Parameters:
      username - the username of the account being verified
      providedAnswers - the answers supplied by the user
      Returns:
      true if all answers match; false otherwise

    • recoverPassword

      public boolean recoverPassword(String username, String newPassword)
      Updates the password for a given user after successful verification.
      Parameters:
      username - the username of the account
      newPassword - the new password to set
      Returns:
      true if the password was updated successfully; false otherwise
